hints.title: Lowest Uncovered Cell Backtracking
hints.text: At each recursive step, find the top-leftmost uncovered cell, then attempt to place all square sizes that fit without overlap.

hints.title: Branch and Bound Blueprint
hints.text: Prune search if current square count >= best_so_far. Place largest possible square down to size 1, updating bitmask or height profile.
